name: aws-lambda-function
title: Lambda function
summary: Runs a container image from ECR on AWS Lambda when something calls it: on a schedule, when messages arrive on a linked queue, or on demand. It gets its own log group and a role that can reach only what it is linked to.
checks: Runs {image} with {memory} MB of memory for at most {timeout} seconds per call
Writes its logs to its own log group, kept {log_retention_days} days
Its role can reach only the tables, buckets, queues and secrets it is linked to

image.title: Container image
image.description: An image in ECR in this account and region, with a tag or digest. Build it with a build step or GitHub Actions.

architecture.title: Processor
architecture.description: The image must be built for it: linux/arm64 for arm64, linux/amd64 for x86_64.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: Optional: rate(5 minutes) or cron(0 9 * * ? *). Empty means no schedule.

batch_size.title: Messages per call
batch_size.description: For linked queues that trigger it.

env.title: Settings
env.description: Plain settings passed as environment variables. Never secrets: link a secret block instead.
